positions.title: Calypso Support Analyst (Java Developer) at Macquarie Bank
positions.description: As a Calypso Analyst with a java development background I have worked on Calypso's transition from development project into production.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: As a java developer at Macquarie I was hired to work inside the Operations team to both create/update tools and software used by the Operations team and more importantly to provide technical depth for investigation and problem solving for production incidents.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the Enterprise Services development team specialising in J2EE MDB's on WebSphere and DB2

Ø	Unix (AIX), Windows (all)
Ø	WebSphere 6.1, Tomcat, IIS
Ø	Core Java/J2EE, Struts, EJB, JSP, Servlets, Hibernate, Spring, MVC, JDBC, XML, JMS, JNDI, HTML, Junit, JaxWS
Ø	VB, C# .NET
Ø	Eclipse, RAD 7.0, Netbeans, CVS, Maven2, Ant
Ø	MS Visual Studio 2005 2008
Ø	Sparx Enterprise Architect, Visio
Ø	MQ Series (WMB) calls from java using Spring
Ø	DB2, MS SQL

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description: My Role at True Alliance was a very broad support role, from users' PC's to Windows Servers to ERP software.  At True Alliance I took part in several large scale projects the largest of which was end to end setup of a new office that doubled as a DR centre.
